Simplify the expression 3x/8 + x/4 + x/2. Show your work.

Answer: ____

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer.title: Answer

output.answer: Work: Write each term with the common denominator 8. x/4 = 2x/8 and x/2 = 4x/8. Then 3x/8 + 2x/8 + 4x/8 = (3 + 2 + 4)x/8 = 9x/8. Answer: 9x/8
